rules.statement: Payment under such circumstances is a good discharge.
rules.supporting_quote: "The principle is laid down by Bonser C.J. in Mohamado v. Ibrahim [1 (1895) 2 N. L. R. 36.] that the law will never compel a person to pay a sum of money a second time which he has paid already under the sanction of a Court of competent jurisdiction, provided that the person has done all that was incumbent on him to resist the payment"
